title: Maryland & Virginia Fresh & Saltwater Fishing Charters
specs: Fishing on multiple rivers and over 30 Maryland and Delaware ponds
Flounder fishing in Virginia's 'flounder capital of the world'
Rockfish fishing using casting techniques, not trolling
Cruises include wildlife viewing with eagles, osprey, and herons
Sign a standard charter boat waiver of claims
Bring your own rods, reels, and tackle or use provided gear at no charge
Up to three passengers per trip
Bringing one guest included in price; two guests discouraged with $50 fee
includes: All Maryland and Virginia fishing licenses furnished
Fishing license, bait, ice, tackle included on flounder trips
Artificial baits furnished for rockfish trips
blurb: Guests fish for bass, flounder, rockfish, and other species on various rivers, ponds, and coastal areas in Maryland and Virginia. Charters include bait, fishing licenses, and optional gear. Cruises for sightseeing, photography, crabbing, clamming, and bird watching are also offered.
extraNote: $100 non-refundable deposit required to book and lock in a day · No credit cards accepted; deposit must arrive to confirm booking · Only operator can cancel or change trip due to health or unsafe weather · No cancellation for rain; rain is considered good fishing · $50 fee added if bringing two guests instead of one · Alcohol consumption while fishing is discouraged · Snow Hill, Maryland or other agreed locations
